projects.name: vr-core-engine
projects.description: High-performance C++/Vulkan rendering engine powering VectorLabs VR experiences. Handles scene graph, draw call batching, foveated rendering, and frame scheduling.

projects.name: headset-sdk
projects.description: Cross-platform SDK abstracting headset hardware (Meta Quest, Pico, HTC Vive, Apple Vision Pro). Exposes unified APIs for tracking, rendering surfaces, and haptics.

projects.name: training-sim-platform
projects.description: Enterprise VR training simulation platform for industrial safety, medical procedures, and compliance workflows. Includes scenario authoring, LMS integration, and analytics.

projects.name: spatial-ui-toolkit
projects.description: UI component library for VR interfaces — curved panels, gaze-driven menus, hand-ray interaction, and accessible spatial layouts built on top of the headset-sdk.

issues.title: Frame drop below 72fps on Quest 3 during scene transitions
issues.description: When transitioning between scenes with > 800 draw calls, framerate falls to 55-60fps causing motion sickness. Reproducible 100% on Quest 3, intermittent on Pico 4. Suspected CPU-GPU sync bubble in the scene unload path.

issues.title: Hand tracking latency spike on SDK v2.3 — Quest 3 regression
issues.description: After upgrading to SDK v2.3, hand tracking reports 22-28ms latency on Quest 3 vs. 8-10ms on v2.2. The regression appears in the gesture normalisation layer introduced in #sdk-238. Blocking SDK v3.0 GA milestone.

issues.title: Spatial audio desync in multi-user sessions after 10 minutes
issues.description: In sessions with 4+ concurrent users, spatial audio cues drift out of sync starting around the 10-minute mark. Audio objects maintain correct 3D position but lag behind visual anchors by 150-400ms. Suspected clock drift in the session coordinator.

issues.title: Implement foveated rendering pipeline for eye-tracked headsets
issues.description: Add support for fixed-foveated and dynamic foveated rendering via the Vulkan VK_EXT_fragment_density_map extension. Expected 30-40% GPU load reduction on eye-tracked devices. Requires eye tracking data fed from headset-sdk.

issues.title: Add eye tracking calibration API to headset-sdk
issues.description: Expose a standardised eye tracking calibration flow across Meta, Pico, and Vision Pro backends. Needed by vr-core-engine for foveated rendering (I4) and spatial-ui-toolkit for gaze selection.

issues.title: Gaze dwell selection fires double-click event intermittently
issues.description: When using gaze-based dwell selection, approximately 1-in-8 selections fires two consecutive click events. Affects all interactive panel types. Suspected debounce logic race condition in GazeDwellHandler.

issues.title: Memory leak in texture streaming — VRAM grows unbounded in long sessions
issues.description: Over a 90-minute session, VRAM usage climbs from ~1.8GB to >3.5GB with no release. Heap profiling points to orphaned VkImageView handles in the streaming eviction path. Fixed in MR !14.

issues.title: LMS SCORM export produces invalid xAPI statements for branching scenarios
issues.description: Branching scenario completions generate xAPI statements with missing 'result.completion' field, causing rejections from Cornerstone and EnterpriseOne SuccessFactors LMS. Affects ~30% of exported training modules.

issues.title: Curved panel renderer clips content at extreme FOV angles (>90°)
issues.description: Content rendered on high-curvature panels (radius < 1.2m) is clipped on the peripheral edges when the user's FOV exceeds 90°. Affects wide-format dashboard layouts in training-sim-platform.

issues.title: Haptic feedback intensity not normalised across Pico and Quest backends
issues.description: The same haptic amplitude value (0.6) produces noticeably different intensities on Pico 4 (weak) vs Quest 3 (strong). Need per-device calibration curves or hardware abstraction in the haptics layer.

issues.title: Add scenario analytics dashboard to training-sim-platform
issues.description: Product request: instructors need a per-session analytics view showing completion rates, time-on-task, and common failure points per scenario step. Design mocks in Figma (link TBC).

issues.title: Document hand-ray interaction model for external contributors
issues.description: The hand-ray raycasting and hit-testing API is undocumented. Multiple external contributors have asked questions in #spatial-ui. Need a guide covering RaycastQuery, InteractionSurface, and the event lifecycle.

merge_requests.title: fix: memory leak in texture streaming eviction path
merge_requests.description: Properly destroy VkImageView handles on eviction. Fixes I7. Tested over 2h session — VRAM stable at 1.85GB.

merge_requests.title: feat: add eye tracking calibration API
merge_requests.description: Introduces EyeTrackingCalibrator with Meta, Pico, and Vision Pro backend implementations. Addresses I5. Gated behind IMMERSALABS_EYE_TRACKING_V2 feature flag.

merge_requests.title: feat: implement foveated rendering via VK_EXT_fragment_density_map
merge_requests.description: Adds fixed and dynamic foveated rendering modes. Dynamic mode requires eye tracking data from headset-sdk (depends on MR2). Partial implementation — fixed mode ready, dynamic mode draft.

merge_requests.title: fix: correct xAPI result.completion field in SCORM export
merge_requests.description: Adds missing completion field to branching scenario xAPI statement builder. Validated against Cornerstone sandbox. Fixes I8.

merge_requests.title: fix: hand tracking latency regression in gesture normalisation layer
merge_requests.description: Reverts the quaternion pre-multiplication order introduced in #sdk-238 and replaces with correct slerp-based normalisation. Latency back to 8-10ms in benchmarks. Fixes I2.

merge_requests.title: fix: debounce race condition in GazeDwellHandler
merge_requests.description: Replaces the timer-based debounce with an atomic state machine. Adds unit tests for rapid gaze-enter/gaze-exit sequences. Fixes I6.

merge_requests.title: feat: scenario analytics dashboard — backend API
merge_requests.description: REST + GraphQL API for per-session analytics: completion rate, time-on-task, and step-level failure heatmap. Frontend MR to follow. Partial implementation of I11.

merge_requests.title: refactor: spatial audio engine — decouple from scene graph
merge_requests.description: Moves the spatial audio subsystem into its own ECS component, breaking the hard dependency on SceneNode. Enables audio-only updates at 60Hz independent of render tick. No functional changes.

milestones.title: SDK v3.0 GA
milestones.description: General availability release of headset-sdk v3.0. Key deliverables: eye tracking calibration API, haptic normalisation, hand tracking latency fixes, and Vision Pro 2 support.

milestones.title: Engine 2.0 Release
milestones.description: Major engine release with foveated rendering, multi-GPU support, and the decoupled spatial audio ECS subsystem. Target: 20% average GPU load reduction vs 1.x.

milestones.title: Training Sim Q3 Launch
milestones.description: Q3 commercial launch of training-sim-platform v2 with new scenario analytics dashboard, xAPI/SCORM 2004 compliance, and spatial audio improvements.

milestones.title: Spatial UI v1.5
milestones.description: Stability and polish release: gaze dwell fixes, curved panel clip fixes, accessibility pass, and contributor documentation for hand-ray interaction.
